exposure: Severe pre-eclampsia with onset before 28 weeks of pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 145 women with severe pre-eclampsia with onset before 28 weeks of pregnancy, with a mean maternal age of 26.97 years.
finding: Expectant management of severe pre-eclampsia before 28 weeks is not routinely recommended before 25+6 weeks gestation due to high stillbirth and perinatal mortality rates, but may be offered between 26 and 27+6 weeks with close monitoring and adequate neonatal services.
gest_age: Onset of severe pre-eclampsia before 28 weeks of pregnancy, with specific recommendations varying for <25+6 weeks and 26 to 27+6 weeks gestation.
